name: Security Scanner PFOE Preset + DIVZ Relabel
description: Add a second built-in preset 'PFOE' to the Security Scanner page and clean up the DIVZ dropdown label. PFOE is a 16-factor growth/quality/sentiment/valuation/momentum screen (Yang Liu's weight table, Teams 2026-07-10T17:12Z; Growth 42% = 6 forward/trailing sales+EPS growth factors at 7 each; Quality 30% = gross_mgn/oper_mgn/fcf_mgn/roe/int_cov at 6 each; Sentiment 10% = eps_stable_est + eps_est_rev_45d at 5 each; Valuation 8% = peg_ntm; Momentum 10% = ret_mom_252d + short_pct_chg_12m at 5 each; sum 100%). DIVZ label 'DIVZ -- Dividend' -> 'DIVZ' (Andrew: 'take out the dividend and the double dash in the drop-down', call 2026-07-10 00:00). Empirically FE-ONLY: presets are declared in portal/src/pages/SecurityScanner/constants.ts, scoring is client-side (compositeScore = sum(pctls*weight)/100), and all 16 PFOE codes are present in the served factor_metadata.json (289 factors, asOf 20260521) -- no backend/Lambda/DS/S3 change. Extends SSCN_DIVDEF's preset-registry model with a second PRESETS entry + a PresetGroup union extension (adds Growth/Sentiment/Valuation).
